title: codecalc canonical computation spec
description: The canonical form of a codecalc execution request, version 1.0.0. Serialize this document as RFC 8785-style JSON (UTF-8, sorted keys, no insignificant whitespace) and sha256 the bytes to obtain the request's spec_hash. Generated from codecalc/providers.py by scripts/check_contract.py — edit the dataclass, not this file.

schema_version.description: The canonical-form version these bytes were produced under. Part of the hashed content: spec hashes are comparable within a version and are NOT expected to survive a bump.

computation_spec.title: the request fields
computation_spec.description: Every field is present in the canonical document even when the dataclass supplies a default, so these bytes reconstruct the request without consulting a default table.

language.description: Runtime key from codecalc's language registry, e.g. 'python3'.

code.description: The program source to execute, verbatim.

stdin.description: Text written to the process's standard input. '' means none.

timeout.description: Wall-clock ceiling in seconds for the whole request.

workdir.description: Working directory for the run, or null to let the provider choose an ephemeral one. null and '' are different requests.

max_memory_mb.description: Address-space ceiling in MiB; 0 means the provider default.

max_output_kb.description: Combined stdout+stderr ceiling in KiB; 0 means uncapped.

max_cpu.description: CPU-time ceiling in seconds; 0 means the provider default.

no_net.description: Request network isolation. Providers that cannot enforce it disclose so in the result's `unenforced` list rather than failing quietly.
